name: Baikonur Site 31/6
tagline: Active Soyuz crewed pad — every ISS Soyuz crew rotation since 2020 has lifted from Site 31
description: The other half of the Baikonur Soyuz operation. Originally an R-7 ICBM pad from 1961; modernised for Soyuz-2.1a in 2014. When Site 1/5 went down for refurbishment in 2019, Site 31 picked up the entire Soyuz crew programme — every Soyuz MS rotation to the ISS since MS-16 in April 2020 has lifted from here. Continuous human spaceflight cadence: roughly two crews per year, with no interruption.
best_known_for: Active Soyuz crewed pad — every ISS Soyuz crew rotation since 2020 has lifted from Site 31
